summary: Defs integration done on branch int/defs (worktree i_defs). tools/check_defs.py is clean, the 1.7 --tests build is clean, unit tests pass (410), and smoke, ui.diag, core.defs and all five *.defs suites pass. The load log has no red errors: the 13+ "Could not find player faction" errors and the duplicate HH_Venue_Casino are gone. Two earlier defs-related failures are fixed: the ui.diag translation keys and the casino.defs tab assertion. Bank, insurance, underworld, city, wellness, kitchen and dlc suites run in the same game as other suites show a few failures. They are guest-behaviour failures like those in the m1 matrix (e.g. dlc.shrine temple fund, casino.slots/tables, kitchen.restaurant) or order-dependent flakes (insurance.claim.limb, underworld.hunt, kitchen.cook, wellness.massage, city.cinema pass when run alone). No guest-behaviour failure was traced to the defs changes.
implemented: One architect tab HH_Hospitality (label Hospitality, order 95, after Joy) defined once in Hospitality_Shared.xml; one HH_Bank tab (order 90) defined once in Core_Banking.xml. The three conditional DesignationCategory patches and the HH_Casino and HH_Underworld categories are removed.

Casino, wellness, city, underworld and the guest altar are in HH_Hospitality; bank buildings are in HH_Bank; kitchen stations stay in Production. Dropdown groups HH_Group_Casino, _Wellness, _City and _Underworld keep the tab tidy, and uiOrder values are set per business. The underworld group stays hidden by the existing gate. HH_GuestAltar moved from Ideology into HH_Hospitality.

New research projects HH_Innkeeping, HH_Gastronomy, HH_HotelManagement and HH_FineDining (Hospitality_Research.xml), plus SL_Insurance and SL_Actuarial (Insurance_Research.xml). Kitchen levels 2, 3 and 4 now map to Innkeeping, Gastronomy and FineDining (DishKnowledge.LevelResearch, RecipeBuilder Signature form). HH_Cooking_L2 to L4 are removed; HH_Cooking_L1 stays as the free root.

Research layout: kitchen/hotel row 0.0, casino and city row 0.7, wellness row 1.4, underworld row 3.0 (hidden). Bank tree: SL_Banking, SL_Branches, SL_Credit, SL_Insurance, SL_Actuarial. Prerequisites flow left to right with no overlaps, and the bank tree has no hotel dependencies. CityLife_1 now needs HotelManagement, Casino_Slots needs Casino_Tables, Bathhouse needs Innkeeping, Casino_Tables needs Innkeeping.

Shared setting core.researchMode (Full/Off) is registered in CoreSettings with CoreSettings.ResearchOff. core.noResearchGating is kept as an alias, and bank.researchMode and city.researchMode still work. Bank, City, Insurance and Kitchen read it. A new ResearchGate class finishes all non-underworld projects of the two tabs at game start, on load and every 600 ticks, so every def-level research gate opens. Underworld projects, found via the UwGateExtension, stay gated by discovery and content intensity.

Startup red errors: Faction.OfPlayer calls in the Harmony patches of InsurancePatches.cs and Dlc/Patches.cs now use OfPlayerSilentFail with a null check. The duplicate HH_Venue_Casino copy is removed from Casino_Research.xml.

Translations: Keyed entries for dlc.traitSpawn and dlc.traitRarity (name and description) in HH_Dlc.xml. New file HH_Research.xml holds the core.researchMode texts and the enum labels. ui.diag passes.

tools/check_defs.py (new): checks duplicate defNames per def type, prefixes, labels and descriptions, missing HH_/SL_ references in XML and C#, research overlap and left-to-right flow, bank independence, Keyed duplicates and missing keys, and leftover conditional category patches.
New in-game suite core.defs (Source/Hearth.Core/Testing/CoreDefsTests.cs): tab uniqueness, research tree layout, and the research mode Off/Full including restoring the state afterwards.
Test edits: KitchenTests and CasinoSuites assertions updated to the new research names and the casino dropdown group.
not_done: SL_InsuranceDesk (insurance desk building) was not created. It needs a texture, and Common/Textures is the art agent's. InsurancePricing counts it only if present.

Concept projects without content in the mod are not defined: HH_Markets, HH_TableGames, HH_ChipsAndCage, HH_CasinoGaming, HH_Lotteries, HH_Rehab, HH_Cinema, HH_Tourism, SL_Securities and others. The shipped content hangs on the existing projects (HH_Casino_Tables, HH_Casino_Slots and so on).
Not changed (outside my scope): HH_FrontDesk is still in Furniture (Inn defs), and HH_VendingMachine still needs vanilla Electricity (Venues defs).
core.noResearchGating is still registered by the UI module and shown in DifficultyPanel, so there are two controls for one thing for now.
No in-game check that the research tree renders without overlap in the real research screen; layout is verified numerically only.
Full guest-behaviour test matrix not re-run on this branch. Failures seen on the branch are listed in the summary.
